Q: How Can I get the Actual values of a List Box or Dropdown List Option from this HTA to a txt file A:

You need to assign an id to each element so that you can get its value into a variable. For example, if your "country" element has id=country, then you can use this VBScript code:

country = country.options[country.selectedIndex].value.

Then you can use the Scripting.FileSystemObject to write the variables out to a text file.

If you post the complete HTA, I'll revise this answer with more details.

Q: Cant Run MAUI Project getting below Error - The Project need to be deployed before we can debug. please enable deploy in the Configuration Manager A:

FWIW, the issue I describe here happens for all WinUI3 projects (so for MAUI projects too I guess). It took me a while to figure what was going on, as I had the "Deploy" configuration checked, but still getting that "please enable deploy in the Configuration Manager" error...

It turns out it also depends on how you've configured the debugger start project.

So, for example, if you have not set the WindowsPackageType property (running as "packaged), then you must use the Visual Studio debugger entry postfixed with "(Package)":

While if you've set WindowsPackageType to None, then you must use the entry postfixed with "(Unpackaged)"

It seems obvious but only while you know it...

Q: Unity TCP client works on Windows but not on Android (same Wi-Fi network) A:

Your

string hostName = Dns.GetHostName();

only works on your Laptop itself of course because it gives you the name of that device the code is running on.

Instead you will have to tell your phone which IP or DNS to use to reach your server running on the Laptop.

In general I would strongly recommend to go for TcpClient instead which is better than going through a raw Socket and supports both, IP or DNS server string.

Same also in the server I would rather go with TcpListener and properly configure it to listen on all interfaces not only e.g. localhost aka 127.0.0.1 - because that would still mean you can only connect locally but not from extern.

Additionally

  • your WiFI router has to allow connections between the devices
    • run a ping check in both directions or at least from phone to server
  • your firewall on the server has to allow the connection

Q: WhatsApp Flows Text Variable Not Rendering in Template String A:

Template strings are currently not supported in Flows.

If you need to calculate such values, you will need to use an endpoint https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/flows/guides/implementingyourflowendpoint

Q: How can I remove all text after a character in Bash? A:

Let's say you have a path with a file in this format:

/dirA/dirB/dirC/filename.file

Now you only want the path which includes four "/"s. Type

echo "/dirA/dirB/dirC/filename.file" | cut -f1-4 -d"/"

and your output will be

/dirA/dirB/dirC

The advantage of using cut is that you can also cut out the uppest directory as well as the file (in this example), so if you type

echo "/dirA/dirB/dirC/filename.file" | cut -f1-3 -d"/"

your output would be

/dirA/dirB

Though you can do the same from the other side of the string, it would not make that much sense in this case as typing

echo "/dirA/dirB/dirC/filename.file" | cut -f2-4 -d"/"

which results in

dirA/dirB/dirC

In some other cases, the last case might also be helpful. Mind that there isn’t any "/" at the beginning of the last output.
